create_video_from_images: create an MP4 video from a list of RGB numpy array images using imageio and FFMPEG
paste_foreground_on_background: paste a foreground image onto a background image at a given location with optional alpha blending
tile_images_into_grid: tile multiple images of non-equal size into a single composite image arranged in columns
draw_collision_overlay: draw translucent red strips on the border of an image to indicate a collision event
append_text_under_image: append wrapped text on a black background underneath an image using OpenCV
